sentences.text: Skolen begynner. Mange elever har lekse.
sentences.english: School begins. Many pupils have homework.

sentences.text: Nils er ti år. Han går på skolen.
sentences.english: Nils is ten years old. He goes to school.

sentences.text: Skolen er stor. Mange elever er på skolen.
sentences.english: The school is big. Many pupils are at the school.

sentences.text: Lars er læreren til Nils.
sentences.english: Lars is Nils's teacher.

sentences.text: Klokka åtte begynner skolen.
sentences.english: At eight o'clock school begins.

sentences.text: Lars sier: «God morgen!» Elevene sier: «God morgen!»
sentences.english: Lars says: "Good morning!" The pupils say: "Good morning!"

sentences.text: Elevene leser. Så skriver Nils.
sentences.english: The pupils read. Then Nils writes.

sentences.text: Nils liker å lese. Han liker ikke å skrive.
sentences.english: Nils likes to read. He does not like to write.

sentences.text: Nils, hvor er boka di?
sentences.english: Nils, where is your book?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Boka er hjemme.
sentences.english: The book is at home.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Hjemme?
sentences.english: At home?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Nei, her er den! Den er i vesken.
sentences.english: No, here it is! It is in the bag.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Mange er glade i dag. Mange liker skolen.
sentences.english: Many are happy today. Many like school.

sentences.text: Klokka tolv spiser elevene mat.
sentences.english: At twelve o'clock the pupils eat.

sentences.text: Nils spiser brød med ost og drikker melk.
sentences.english: Nils eats bread with cheese and drinks milk.

sentences.text: Etter maten begynner skolen. Nå begynner Lars.
sentences.english: After the meal school begins. Now Lars begins.

sentences.text: Så er skolen slutt.
sentences.english: Then school is over.

sentences.text: Er skolen slutt, Nils?
sentences.english: Is school over, Nils?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, nå er skolen slutt.
sentences.english: Yes, now school is over.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Nils går hjem til Marta.
sentences.english: Nils goes home to Marta.

sentences.text: Hei, Nils! Har du lekse?
sentences.english: Hello, Nils! Do you have homework?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, jeg har lekse.
sentences.english: Yes, I have homework.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Er leksa stor?
sentences.english: Is the homework big?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nei, den er liten. Jeg vil skrive litt.
sentences.english: No, it is small. I want to write a little.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Bra! Marta sier: «Ha det bra, Nils!»
sentences.english: Good! Marta says: "Goodbye, Nils!"
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nils er glad. Han liker Marta.
sentences.english: Nils is happy. He likes Marta.

sentences.text: Sam er ikke på skolen. Han er hjemme. Han er glad.
sentences.english: Sam is not at school. He is at home. He is happy.

sentences.text: Hei, Sam! Hvordan går det?
sentences.english: Hi, Sam! How are you?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Det går bra! Jeg er i rommet. Jeg liker norsk!
sentences.english: I am fine! I am in my room. I like Norwegian!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Bra! Du snakker norsk, og du vil lese norsk.
sentences.english: Good! You speak Norwegian, and you want to read Norwegian.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, jeg vil snakke norsk hver dag.
sentences.english: Yes, I want to speak Norwegian every day.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Lars er trøtt etter skolen. Han vil ha kaffe.
sentences.english: Lars is tired after school. He wants coffee.

sentences.text: Hei, Lars! Hvordan går det?
sentences.english: Hi, Lars! How are you?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Det går bra, men jeg er trøtt. Jeg liker skolen.
sentences.english: I am fine, but I am tired. I like the school.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Her er kaffe, Lars. Du jobber mye.
sentences.english: Here is coffee, Lars. You work a lot.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Takk, Anna! Du er bra.
sentences.english: Thanks, Anna! You are good.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Rommet til Nils er lite, men vinduet er stort. Han har ei seng og en bok.
sentences.english: Nils's room is small, but the window is big. He has a bed and a book.

sentences.text: Etter skolen går Nils til kafeen. Han vil ha ost og melk, men han er mett.
sentences.english: After school Nils goes to the café. He wants cheese and milk, but he is full.

sentences.text: Nils har penger, og han vil kjøpe epler. Epler er billig, og brød er ikke dyrt.
sentences.english: Nils has money, and he wants to buy apples. Apples are cheap, and bread is not expensive.

sentences.text: Mora og faren til Nils er hjemme. Familien er glad.
sentences.english: Nils's mother and father are at home. The family is happy.
